rules.review_note: Keep Info, exact SHA256/entropy human text, CPU capability and platform preprocessor guards, ordering and all cryptographic initialization. Record algorithm label only; no randomness, seeds or keys. Copy local algorithm string before its destruction. RdSeed/RdRand runtime is not exercised on macOSarm64.
